svg.title: TSNR2 HDU deep-dive
svg.desc: The 33 columns of the TSNR2 HDU from redrock-main-dark-0.fits, described by naming pattern and grouped by target class type.
svg.text: Columns follow two patterns: TSNR2_{TARGET}_{CAMERA} for per-camera values and TSNR2_{TARGET} for
the camera-summed total. All values are float32 except TARGETID (int64).
int64 · Joins to REDSHIFTS, FIBERMAP, and the coadd file.
5 target classes × 3 cameras + 5 camera-summed totals = 20 columns
ELG = Emission Line Galaxy · LRG = Luminous Red Galaxy · BGS = Bright Galaxy Survey
QSO = Quasi-Stellar Object · LYA = Lyman-alpha Forest
Template SNR² measures the effective depth of a spectrum for fitting a given target class.
3 GPB classes × 3 cameras + 3 camera-summed totals = 12 columns
GPB = Global Pass-Band. These metrics characterize the effective depth of an observation
relative to the observing program (dark, bright, backup) rather than a specific target class.
TSNR2 shares the 1704-target row axis with REDSHIFTS and FIBERMAP. Camera-summed totals
(no camera suffix) are the sum of the B, R, and Z per-camera values for that target class.
